description.content: Molecule similarity searching using Tanimoto coefficient.
Search for molecules similar to a given SMILES string using Tanimoto coefficient. Returns molecules above the specified similarity threshold.

query.description: Number of records to return per page (default 20, max 1000)
Number of records to skip for pagination

variable.description: (Required) SMILES string of the query molecule (URL-encoded)

info.name: ChEMBL Data REST Activity Similarity API

description.content:
ChEMBL is a manually curated database of bioactive molecules with drug-like properties, maintained by the EMBL-EBI. This REST API provides programmatic access to bioactive molecules, drug targets, bioactivity measurements, approved drugs, assay data, and clinical trial compound information. ChEMBL_37 contains over 2.9 million distinct compounds, 24.5 million activities, and 18,552 targets.

Contact Support:
 Name: ChEMBL Team
 Email: chembl-help@ebi.ac.uk
